open_points.subject: M06 TrialCase + M21 StoredValue vs `many` file ports
open_points.text: M06 defines `inputs` and `expected_outputs` as "StoredValues (M21) by ... port" (one item per port), while M21 allows `carriage: file` only as a single trial fixture record; but A03 rule 3 and A09 rule 2 allow `many` file ports (lists of files).
open_points.question: How are trial cases and admission expected-output checks represented for a file port with `cardinality: many` (including order and duplicates), or is such a port shape forbidden?
options: Forbid `many` on all `file` ports at contract/binding validation.
Allow `many` file ports and change trial-case structures to store an ordered list of file fixtures per port.
Encode `many` file values as one `value`-carriage JSON list of file references (changing current fixture semantics).
open_points.default_guess: Refuse `many` file ports until data models explicitly support ordered multiple fixtures per port.

open_points.subject: M22 SpooledFile identity for multi-file outputs
open_points.text: M22 identity fields are `run_id`, `producer_node_id`, `map_index`, `attempt_number`, `producer_port`, `content_digest`, `size_bytes`, `media_type`, `disclosure_class`; there is no per-port file position, yet A03 rule 3/A09 rule 2 allow multiple files on one `many` file port in one attempt.
open_points.question: How does the kernel distinguish and preserve order/multiplicity when one attempt produces multiple files on the same output port, especially two identical files (same digest and size)?
options: Add a file index (position) to spool identity and to NodeExecution file references.
Disallow multiple files per output port in one attempt (`many` file outputs forbidden).
Collapse identical files by digest (loses multiplicity/order semantics).
open_points.default_guess: Add an explicit per-port file index and treat each list element as a distinct spooled-file reference.
